name: Kureteeru Oruju
original_name: クレテール・オルジュ
source: Deputy Head of "Iru Izore" organisation, a smart and self-collected, but kind at heart  woman, you can always rely on. Kureteeru has played an important role in this story. And she seems in love with Rodden.
